studies.label: 2x2 online experiment: AI access x incentive (short story writing)

counts_source.locator: PDF p. 3, Section 3.1; PDF p. 5, Table 2 caption; PDF p. 25, Appendix A.2
counts_source.quote: 200 participants from Prolific, with 50 participants per group. ... In all, the strategies we employed are quite conservative, and we managed to filter out 29 Prolific workers.

arms.name: AI-O
arms.description: Integrated GPT5-mini chat assistant available during writing; bonus instructions reward originality and uniqueness relative to other writers. Same assistant configuration as AI-T. PDF pp. 4, 18-20.

arms.name: SELF-O
arms.description: Writing alone in a text editor; external AI forbidden; bonus instructions reward originality and uniqueness relative to other writers. PDF pp. 4, 18-20.

arms.name: AI-T
arms.description: Integrated GPT5-mini chat assistant available during writing; bonus instructions reward organization and technique, explicitly excluding creativity. Same assistant configuration as AI-O. PDF pp. 4, 18-20.

arms.name: SELF-T
arms.description: Writing alone in a text editor; external AI forbidden; bonus instructions reward organization and technique, explicitly excluding creativity. PDF pp. 4, 18-20.

studies.task: Write a 250–350-word first-person short story centered on a decision or dilemma and taking place over no more than one day, after outlining without AI (PDF p. 3, Section 3.1; PDF p. 20, Appendix A.1.3).

ai_tool.name: OpenAI GPT5-Mini (gpt5-mini, reasoning set to medium)
ai_tool.locator: PDF p. 1, Introduction; PDF p. 20, Appendix A.1.4: "The AI assistant was gpt5-mini with reasoning set to medium, and we capped usage to 15 calls/prompts for each session." Release year is not stated.

preregistration.where: OSF: https://osf.io/3u8tq/overview?view_only=e1a8044dd5044bc59dd0a7d8f3fca3c2 (PDF p. 3, footnote 2; also PDF p. 2, footnote 1). Preregistration status is reported by the paper; the external registration was not accessed.
preregistration.primary_outcome: Diversity of final stories, assessed using the prespecified suite of embedding and n-gram/token metrics. Section 4 states these final-submission analyses were preregistered (PDF p. 5); Section 7.2 names diversity as the primary outcome (PDF p. 14). No single metric is designated the sole preregistered primary.

estimates.notes: Final participant submissions; full analyzed cell contrast at the stated randomized incentive level, with no adoption or experience subgroup restriction. The table reports a raw difference in means, not a standardized effect. Exact analyzed denominators cannot be confirmed after exclusions; no sample count is inferred from recruitment totals. Welch tests use one within-cell leave-one-out score per participant (PDF pp. 6–7). These scores reuse the same stories across comparisons; no correction for that dependence is described. Numerical SDs, SEs, confidence limits, t statistics and degrees of freedom are not printed for this contrast. Figure 15 plots levels and error bars without numerical labels or an uncertainty definition (PDF p. 28). Preregistered_primary refers to the diversity metric suite, not a uniquely nominated individual metric (PDF pp. 5–6, 14). p_value is the unadjusted, one-sided Welch-test bound encoded by the black stars, not an exact p-value. Matching red BH-adjusted significance stars encode the same p-value bound as the black stars; PDF p. 28, Table 5, same cell and caption. The red marks were checked separately using PDF text-span colors. The final-story arm means are rounded values printed in prose. The difference is transcribed from Table 5, not calculated from these means. The other value in the control-mean quote describes first AI drafts and is not extracted.

open_items: Exact overall and per-arm randomized/analyzed counts remain unconfirmed: Section 3.1 reports 200 recruited and 50 per group, and Table 2 repeats 50, but Appendix A.2 reports 29 filtered workers and a described post-hoc SELF exclusion without reconciling the participant flow (PDF pp. 3, 5, 20, 25). No total or per-contrast count is calculated from these statements.
Numerical arm means are unavailable except for the prose MiniLM AI-O and SELF-O final means; the remaining arm levels are plotted only (PDF pp. 8–9, 28).

No numerical outcome SDs, SEs, CIs, test statistics, degrees of freedom, or exact p-values are printed for the extracted contrasts. The definition and level of plotted error bars/bands are not stated (PDF pp. 7, 9, 28–29).

Compression-ratio and NGDS implementations as pairwise within-cell scores are not supplied, despite the general participant-level leave-one-out formula. Dependence from shared story pairs is also not addressed in the Welch-test description (PDF pp. 6–7).
The paper does not state the release year of GPT5-Mini, so ai_tool.year is null (PDF pp. 1, 20).

The citation record identifies a later workshop report, whereas the supplied retrieval entry and on-file document are arXiv v1. This extraction uses the specified saved PDF; equivalence to the later report was not verified.

Out-of-scope source ambiguities remain: Table 5 First (AI) comparator labels versus Figure 1 (PDF pp. 7, 28); Figure 6 versus Table 6 subgroup significance marks (PDF pp. 12, 30); and the conditioning set for the Section 6.2 claim about no significant AI-O versus AI-T diversity change (PDF p. 11). None is used to fill the final-story AI-access estimates.
notes: Independent extraction B, 2026-10-11. Read the complete markdown conversion in six contiguous chunks, including references and appendices; extracted PDF page text with pymupdf and checked tables and figures. All retained statistics are from the saved PDF. Table 5 supplies twelve metrics for each of the two AI-versus-SELF contrasts: seven embedding measures and five lexical/token measures; both numerical MiniLM arm levels come from Section 5.2. Values are raw differences, with no effect-size, standard-error, sample-count or sign calculations. Source quotes retain printed decimal precision, including trailing zeros, and normalize whitespace and PDF font-map artifacts in minus signs, star markers and comparison signs to the visible glyphs. Black and red significance stars were checked separately from PDF text-span colors. S1-O1 and S1-O2 are each split by metric to retain every reported result. No combined AI-versus-SELF contrast is printed. Incentive-cell AI-access contrasts are the paper’s full-cell tests, not adoption/moderation subgroup analyses. Exact counts remain null consistently with the final screening correction; the demographic and recruitment counts do not establish final analysis denominators. Table 4’s disjoint high- and low-adoption analyzed groups support the screening eligibility decision, but do not provide full-sample counts. AI was available during the scored writing in treatment arms, with no later unassisted task. No sample overlap is stated in the paper or mapped in the screening form. The preregistered primary is the diversity suite; all-MiniLM-L12-v2 is featured in Section 5, but no sole preregistered primary metric is named. Authors’ actual bonus payments were fixed after completion, without grading the stories (PDF p. 25).
